column1: # comment: "GMEOW term to Wikidata Q-item alignments (concept-scheme layer; QIDs validated)."

column7: comment
Wikidata 'agent' is a very abstract philosophical concept; GMEOW Agent is the actor in provenance and trust assertions. Directional lossy projection.
Wikidata 'social group' is broader than GMEOW Group (which includes non-social collectives). Directional lossy projection.
Wikidata 'mailbox' is primarily physical; GMEOW Mailbox covers both physical and electronic. Directional lossy projection.
Wikidata 'media file' is broader than GMEOW MediaObject (which includes non-file media); directional lossy projection
Wikidata 'graduation ceremony' is narrower than GMEOW eventTypeGraduation (which covers any educational completion); directional lossy projection
Wikidata P424 is the Wikimedia language code; GMEOW languageCode uses BCP-47. Related but not identical.
lang:CommunicativeAct records what a use of a form does; wd:Q25481968 (speech act — an utterance that serves a performative function) is the same notion. A concept-scoped match, so skos:closeMatch.
lang:CommunicativeForce is the illocutionary force of a communicative act; wd:Q1599204 (illocutionary act, coined by J. L. Austin) is the same category. A concept-scoped match, so skos:closeMatch.

lang:CompositionRule is a rule of the compositional program building a composed denotation from its constituents; wd:Q936559 (principle of compositionality) is the principle it realizes. A concept-scoped match, so skos:closeMatch.

The Montagovian program (wd:Q3272938, Montague grammar) is the compositional-semantics framework lang:CompositionRule draws its fragment from. A related framework rather than identity, so skos:relatedMatch.
lang:Denotation is the reified record of what a form means; wd:Q1189753 (denotation — the literal meaning of a sign) is the semiotic notion GMEOW reifies. A concept-scoped match, so skos:closeMatch.

lang:IndexicalAnchor is the deictic centre an interpretation act resolves indexicals against; wd:Q340015 (deixis) is the phenomenon it anchors. A related notion rather than identity, so skos:relatedMatch.
lang:Sense is a lexicalized way of meaning; wd:Q1570700 (word sense — one of the meanings of a word) is the same notion at the lexical level. A concept-scoped match, so skos:closeMatch.

lang:corefersWith links two referring expressions naming one discourse referent; wd:Q63087 (coreference — when two or more expressions refer to the same thing) is the same relation. A concept-scoped match, so skos:closeMatch.
lang:english is the English natural language; wd:Q1860 (English) is the same language. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
lang:featCase is the Case feature key; wd:Q128234 (case) is the linguistic category — categorization of nouns and modifiers by function. A concept-scoped match, so skos:closeMatch.
lang:featNumber is the Number feature key; wd:Q104083 (grammatical number) is the linguistic category. A concept-scoped match to the feature-inventory key, so skos:closeMatch.
lang:featTense is the Tense feature key; wd:Q177691 (tense) is the linguistic category locating a situation in time. A concept-scoped match, so skos:closeMatch.
lang:latinScript is the Latin script; wd:Q8229 (Latin script) is the same character repertoire. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
lang:noun is the noun part of speech; wd:Q1084 (noun) is the same category. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.

lang:presupposes relates a form to the content it presupposes; wd:Q1076131 (presupposition — assumed context surrounding an utterance) is the phenomenon. A related notion (a property vs a concept), so skos:relatedMatch.
lang:verb is the verb part of speech; wd:Q24905 (verb) is the same category. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:AbelianGroup is a group with a commutative operation; wd:Q181296 (abelian group) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:AlgebraicStructure is a set equipped with operations satisfying axioms; wd:Q205464 (algebraic structure) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:Automorphism is an isomorphism of a structure with itself; wd:Q782566 (automorphism) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:AutomorphismGroup is the group of a structure's automorphisms — its symmetry group; wd:Q60790315 (automorphism group) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:CartanMatrix is the integer matrix of Cartan integers of a root system's simple roots; wd:Q2004951 (Cartan matrix) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:CommutativeRing is a ring whose multiplication commutes; wd:Q858656 (commutative ring) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:DynkinDiagram is the graph classifying a root system's simple roots; wd:Q5319218 (Dynkin diagram) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.

math:EncryptionScheme is the scheme (key + encrypt/decrypt maps); wd:Q141090 (encryption) names the process. closeMatch, not identity: the scheme and the process are close but non-invertible counterparts.
math:Field is a commutative ring whose non-zero elements form a multiplicative group; wd:Q190109 (field) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:Group is a monoid in which every element has an inverse; wd:Q83478 (group) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:GroupAction is the action of a group on a set compatible with the group operation; wd:Q288465 (group action) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:GroupHomomorphism preserves the group operation; wd:Q868169 (group homomorphism) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:GroupRepresentation is a homomorphism of a group into a general linear group; wd:Q1055807 (group representation) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:HomomorphicEncryptionScheme is a scheme allowing computation on ciphertexts; wd:Q2154943 (homomorphic encryption) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:Homomorphism is a structure-preserving map between algebraic structures; wd:Q215111 (homomorphism) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:Ideal is an additive subgroup of a ring closed under multiplication by any ring element; wd:Q44649 (ideal, ring theory) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:Isomorphism is an invertible structure-preserving map; wd:Q189112 (isomorphism) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:Lattice is a discrete subgroup of a real vector space that spans it; wd:Q1096885 (lattice, the discrete-subgroup sense) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.

math:LatticeHardnessAssumption is the hardness assumption a scheme rests on; wd:Q6497083 (lattice-based cryptography) names the cryptographic family built on such assumptions. closeMatch: the assumption and the family that uses it are close but non-invertible counterparts.
math:LieAlgebra is the infinitesimal structure of a Lie group — a vector space with an alternating bracket; wd:Q664495 (Lie algebra) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:LieGroup is a group that is also a smooth manifold; wd:Q622679 (Lie group) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:Module is an abelian group with a compatible ring-scalar action; wd:Q18848 (module) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:Monoid is a semigroup with an identity element; wd:Q208237 (monoid) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:Morphism is a structure-preserving map between objects; wd:Q1948412 (morphism) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:PolynomialRing is the ring R[x] of polynomials over a base ring; wd:Q1455652 (polynomial ring) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.

math:Quotient is the general quotient of a structure by a compatible substructure; wd:Q1138961 (quotient group) is its canonical group instance. closeMatch, not identity: math:Quotient is broader (ring and module quotients too), so the map to the group-specific concept is a close but non-invertible counterpart.
math:Ring is an abelian additive group with a distributive multiplication; wd:Q161172 (ring) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:RingHomomorphism preserves both ring operations; wd:Q1194212 (ring homomorphism) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:RootSystem is the finite root configuration of a semisimple Lie group; wd:Q534131 (root system) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:Semigroup is a magma with an associative operation; wd:Q207348 (semigroup) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:VectorSpace is a module over a field; wd:Q125977 (vector space) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:WeylGroup is the reflection symmetry group of a root system; wd:Q768074 (Weyl group) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.

math:complexNumbers is the system ℂ; wd:Q11567 (complex number) names the number-type concept. closeMatch: the system individual and the number-type concept are close counterparts, not invertibly the same object.

math:eulerMascheroni is the exact constant γ; wd:Q273023 (Euler–Mascheroni constant) is the same constant — the limiting difference between the harmonic series and the natural logarithm. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:eulerNumber is the exact constant e; wd:Q82435 (Euler's number) is the same constant — the base of the natural logarithm. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:integers is the system ℤ; wd:Q12503 (integer) names the number-type concept. closeMatch: the system individual and the number-type concept are close counterparts, not invertibly the same object.
math:learningWithErrors is the LWE hardness problem; wd:Q6510239 (learning with errors) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.

math:naturalNumbers is the system ℕ; wd:Q21199 (natural number) names the number-type concept. closeMatch, not identity: the system individual and the (deliberately ambiguous — non-negative or positive) number-type concept are close counterparts, not invertibly the same object.
math:pi is the exact constant π; wd:Q167 (pi) is the same constant — the ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.

math:rationalNumbers is the system ℚ; wd:Q1244890 (rational number) names the number-type concept. closeMatch: the system individual and the number-type concept are close counterparts, not invertibly the same object.

math:realNumbers is the system ℝ; wd:Q12916 (real number) names the number-type concept. closeMatch: the system individual and the number-type concept are close counterparts, not invertibly the same object.
math:ringLearningWithErrors is the RLWE hardness problem; wd:Q25303820 (Ring Learning with Errors) is the same concept. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
